## Closing checklist

- [ ] The Sprint Review record is posted as a comment
- [ ] The Sprint Retrospective record is posted as a comment
- [ ] PBIs from the Review are filed
- [ ] Improvement actions from the Retrospective are filed as issues where needed
- [ ] Unfinished PBIs are set back to Todo and their Sprint is cleared
